summary: Frontend-only testing of the 'Powers Experience' section changes: Behlen logo move, sidebar caption update, layout tightening. All 6 acceptance criteria verified at 1440x900 viewport via Playwright DOM inspection and visual screenshots.

1_behlen_logo_in_left_column.detail: data-testid=behlen-logo-link is inside .ev-h2-col (left column), grandparent is 'ev-top-grid wipe wipe-d1'. isInsideSidebar=false, isInsideEvH2Col=true. Logo /behlen-country-logo.png loads correctly.

2_behlen_logo_link_new_window.detail: href=https://www.behlencountry.com/, target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer. Link confirmed via DOM property check.

3_sidebar_caption_text.detail: it-sidebar-footer text: 'Scheduling rebuilt. Downtime down 77%. Output per welder up 50%. An execution capability that didn't exist now runs itself.' — exact match. No img elements inside sidebar footer (sidebarFooterImgs=0).

4_no_border_top_on_sidebar_footer.detail: Computed border-top-width=0px, border-top-style=solid (none on CSS). CSS reads: .it-sidebar-footer { padding-top: 10px; } — no border-top rule present.

5_section_fits_single_viewport_1440x900.detail: Section height=788px, scroll container clientHeight=900px, viewport innerHeight=900px. fitsInViewport=true, overflow=0px. Section from eyebrow through stats fits entirely in one snap viewport at 1440x900.

6_five_stats_visible.detail: Stats grid (5 children confirmed). Final values counted up: $1B+, 98%, 5 wks, 500+, 30+. Screenshot confirms all 5 stat labels (Annualized savings, Client retention, Median time, Operations strengthened, Years of frontline leadership) visible.

7_play_button_functional.detail: data-testid=testimonial-play-btn visible. After click with scroll-into-view, data-testid=testimonial-iframe appears and is visible. YouTube shows 'Video unavailable' in preview env due to domain restriction — expected behavior, not an app bug. Confirmed working in iteration_21 manual test.

critical_code_review_comments: All 6 acceptance criteria pass. No regressions found against iteration_21 test results.
Section height 788px at 1440x900 gives ~112px breathing room below the stats — comfortable one-viewport fit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_22: All 6 acceptance criteria for the Powers Experience section changes pass at 1440x900. Behlen logo: left column (ev-h2-col), linked to behlencountry.com in _blank. Sidebar: caption-only (no logo), correct text, no border-top. Section height 788px fits in 900px viewport. 5 stats ($1B+, 98%, 5wks, 500+, 30+) all visible. Play button triggers YouTube iframe.
